verdict.rationale: Microsoft's docs claim codes don't require internet connectivity (microsoft-authenticator-docs-2), but hands-on community reports contradict this for real-world use: work/school accounts are often push-notification only requiring network (comm-9), and one user reports the app 'doesn't generate a code until I first log into the vpn using exchange creds' (comm-10), while another notes MS's QR provisioning is non-standard and locks users into the vendor ecosystem (comm-6). This shows offline TOTP generation is unreliable or restricted in common enterprise deployments, directly conflicting with the vendor's blanket claim. Missing for 10: consistent first-party confirmation that ALL account types (not just personal) generate codes fully offline without any vendor account tie-in, and hands-on verification that TOTP mode works without network for work/school accounts.
